name: Amol Pawar
player_statement:
A complete player, Amol Pawar has made a big mark in cricket. With 30 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 28, with an average of 9.35 and a quick strike rate of 159.26. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 18 sixes and 10 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 56.1 overs, taking 38 wickets at an economy rate of 9.93. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
